about: the fusion scan (pipeline/check_fusion.py; the orchestrator, 2026-11-13 04:44): by level and source, the records with a candidate on several party lines, how many count the candidate over every line (summed) and which count one line (one_line); then a second count of every governor 2006-2020 that Algara and Amlani also hold, since a source that prints one line names one party and is found only by a second count (CT and NY 2018, now every line by pipeline/governor_counts.py)

klarner.how: one row a candidate and line in the source; the intake adds a candidate's rows by candidate id (a['votes'] += v) and keeps the lines' names in lines, so every record built from them counts every line

president: the FEC's tables give each nominee's votes over every line (pipeline/intake/fec_federal_elections.py: 'summed over the party lines they ran on'); the 2024 check of MEDSL's precincts against them (local_medsl.quality) is within 0.01% in NY and exact in CT

governor_second_count.rule: the record's two nominees against Algara and Amlani's county returns summed; listed where either differs by more than the line
